title: Camps, facilities and routes in Mina as mapped in OpenStreetMap

headline.label: camps measured, 290 within 5 minutes of a health point

service.name: Hajj and Umrah Facility and Route Mapping

data: OpenStreetMap through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20: camps, hospitals, clinics, toilets, civil defence, information points, Mashaer metro stops, the Jamarat Bridge and the walking network in the box 21.4 to 21.435 N, 39.855 to 39.915 E.
method: Classify features by their tags: tourism=camp_site for camps, amenity or healthcare for hospitals and clinics, amenity=toilets and fire_station, tourism=information, railway for stops.
OpenStreetMap walking network of paths and streets at 4.8 km/h: 5 min = 400 m and 10 min = 800 m.
For each camp: shortest walking distance from a point inside it to the nearest mapped hospital or clinic, and to the Jamarat Bridge.
Completeness: count per feature type, share with a name, and median year of the last edit.
limits: OpenStreetMap completeness in Mina is unknown: there is no open reference to measure it against, so counts describe what is mapped, not what exists, and toilets and medical points inside camps are mostly not mapped. Camp outlines and numbers may not match the approved plan for the season. Walking distance on the mapped network ignores crowding, closed routes and movement schedules; this is not crowd analysis or a safety plan.
